key_concepts: Classification of living things reflects life’s diversity
Humans are classified in Class Mammalia and Order Primates
Mammals are endothermic, have hair or fur, bear live young, and produce milk
Mammals have specialized teeth and highly developed brains
Primates have grasping hands with opposable thumbs and forward-facing eyes
Primates have complex social structures and relatively large brains

In Homo sapiens, Homo is the genus and sapiens is the species
The three domains of life are Archaea, Bacteria, and Eukarya
Archaea include extremophiles and Bacteria have diverse metabolic roles
